sources.text: Human: ExportLedger timestamps must use UTC, regardless of the operator timezone.

Agent: ExportLedger dashboard polish review: the preview panel heading is now blue, the loading badge has a new spinner, and the toolbar icons have been aligned with the navigation. These are display cosmetics; this review did not examine exported data formats.
Human: CacheShard assigns a tenant to a shard by tenant ID; this is the approved isolation boundary.

Agent: CacheShard proposal: perhaps routing by request ID would spread hot tenants across workers. This is an untested hypothesis, not an approved migration. No load test, isolation review, or decision has occurred; do not treat this exploration as established policy.
Human: WireDecode on main must continue accepting version 1 for backward compatibility.
Human: WireDecode on experiment accepts version 2 only. Reject version 1 here. This branch experiment is not approved for main.
Human: FlushQueue uses batches of 100 records; this is the initial limit.
Human: Reduce FlushQueue batches to 10 records while investigating queue stalls. This replaces the initial 100-record limit.
Human: The FlushQueue investigation is complete. Set batches to 50 records; this replaces both the initial 100 and temporary 10 limits.
Human: ArchiveSync must encrypt every archive before upload. This requirement stays in force.
Human: Add compression to ArchiveSync uploads. This adds a requirement; it does not replace any existing one.
Human: ProbeDial timeout is 10 seconds for the current deployment.

Human: ProbeDial timeout will become 30 seconds effective October 1, 2026. This is a future rollout decision, not an immediate deployment change. The rollout is scheduled after the September audit; no early activation has been approved.

facts.text: ExportLedger must export timestamps in UTC.
CacheShard uses tenant ID for approved shard assignment.
